Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer says stock of Parachute 500 ml is low and wants to order.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Capture SKU and quantity; validate stock; read back and obtain confirmation.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer says they are busy and asks for a call after 5 PM.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Acknowledge; record callback preference; do not push an order.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer requests a SKU that has zero distributor inventory.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Explain unavailability; offer only a relevant in-stock alternative without pressure.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer changes a requested quantity from 10 to 15 before confirmation.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Update order state and confirm the latest quantity only.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer starts in Hindi and switches to English mid-call.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Adapt language without losing conversation context.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer says the last order arrived with the wrong quantity.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Acknowledge; capture complaint; do not ignore issue.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer asks for 2 boxes of a SKU, but pack conversion is not supplied.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Clarify units; do not guess conversion.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer asks for an unauthorised additional discount.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Do not invent or promise a discount;

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer explicitly asks to speak to a sales representative.
Retailer says 'send a few more than last time'.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Ask a clarifying question; do not infer a quantity.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer says 'Parachute small bottle' where multiple SKUs may match.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Clarify pack size before adding SKU.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer requests more units than distributor stock.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: State available quantity and ask whether to revise or split/follow up.
Pass_Criteria: Order does not exceed available stock.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer orders Parachute and has a relevant Saffola purchase history.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Make one relevant, contextual recommendation; accept refusal gracefully.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Person answering says this is not the named retailer.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Do not disclose retailer purchase history; apologise and end or verify safely.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer says do not call again.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Respect request and flag do-not-call preference.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Retailer corrects the agent's read-back summary.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Correct order and repeat full summary before confirmation.

Retailer_Statement_or_Setup: Speech recognition is uncertain about SKU or quantity.
Retailer says they are stocked up but mentions a competitor promotion.
Expected_Agent_Behaviour: Capture useful market insight if appropriate; do not force an order.
